paragraphs.text: New Yotia was a city during the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria .

After the Brothers' War and the fall of the nation of Yotia , a new city of refugees grew on the banks of the Mardun . This city received the name New Yotia. A busy river port for the region's trappers, miners, and farmers, it carried on the traditions of old Yotia. Most of the refugees of Penregon settled in New Yotia, fleeing the encroaching ice for years until the Fall of Penregon . The kingdom was later absorbed into the nation Argive , and eventually fell along with most other nations during the troubled Dark Age . Eventually, the land where New Yotia was located would be inundated in the Flooding of Terisiare , and submerged beneath the Sea of Laments .
